acceptance.given: The Q2 authoring stage is evaluated against the frozen requirements allowlist and repository change manifest.

oracle.expected: Scope validation confirms every Q2 change is confined to the four declared test modules, scripts/sc/tests/skill_quality_support.py, and scripts/sc/tests/fixtures/skill-quality/**, with no production or requirements-input files changed.
forbidden: A changed path outside the declared Q2 allowlist.
A changed production file or requirements-input file.
oracle.observable: A changed-path and fixture-classification artifact enumerates repository-relative paths and verifies each against the exact Q2 allowlist.

acceptance.then: The scope check records only allowlisted test, helper, and fixture paths and accepts only positive, boundary, negative, legacy, or migrated fixture classes.
acceptance.when: During Q2 scope validation, inspect the changed-path manifest and fixture classifications before implementation proceeds.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The Q2 scope check fails when the changed-path manifest contains a production file, the requirements input, or any path outside the four declared test modules, scripts/sc/tests/skill_quality_support.py, and scripts/sc/tests/fixtures/skill-quality/**.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the frozen Q2 authoring boundary for test modules, shared test support, and skill-quality fixtures while excluding production and requirements-input changes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only Q2 test, support, and fixture additions; preserve production, schema, policy, ADR, and requirements-input state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Q2 moves from a declared exact allowlist to authored tests, support, and fixtures confined to that allowlist.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The changed-path and fixture-classification check passes only when every Q2 path is allowlisted and no production or requirements-input path appears.
